Access points bridge 802.11 wireless clients onto the wired campus infrastructure (often via CAPWAP to a WLC in lightweight designs).
They are not primarily DDoS prevention appliances via SNMP.
First line of defense is typically fifirewall/edge security, not the AP’s core role definition.
User authentication may involve 802.1X with RADIUS, but the fundamental AP role is wireless-to-wired attachment.
Correct: connect wireless devices to a wired network.

enunciado: An implementer is preparing hardware for virtualization to create virtual machines on a host. What is needed to provide communication between hardware and virtual machines?
alternativas: router
hypervisor
switch
straight cable
explicacao_profunda:
The hypervisor (VMM) abstrafficts physical hardware and presents virtual hardware to VMs, mediating CPU, memory, storage, and I/O between host hardware and guests.
A physical router or switch may connect the host northbound but is not what enables VM-to-hardware virtualization communication on the host.
A straight-through cable is irrelevant to the hypervisor role.
Hypervisor is required.

enunciado: In which situation is private IPv4 addressing appropriate for a new subnet on the network of an organization?
alternativas: The network has multiple endpoint listeners, and it is desired to limit the number of broadcasts.
The ISP requires the new subnet to be advertised to the Internet for web services.
There is limited unique address space, and traffic on the new subnet will stay local within the organization.
Traffic on the subnet must traverse a site-to-site VPN to an outside organization.
explicacao_profunda:
RFC1918 private addressing is ideal when hosts stay internal (or use NAT/VPN carefully) and public IPv4 space is scarce.
If the ISP must advertise the subnet for public web services, public (or provider-assigned) addressing is required, not pure private without NAT strategy.
Broadcast control is a L2 design issue, not the reason private addressing was created.
Site-to-site VPN can carry private addresses, but the option as written is not the cleanest “most appropriate” vs internal-only traffic with limited public space.
Best answer: limited unique space and local traffic stays inside the organization.

enunciado: Which 802.11 frame type is indicated by a probe response after a client sends a probe request?
alternativas: data
management
control
action
explicacao_profunda:
Probe request/response are 802.11 management frames used for network discovery.
Data frames carry MSDU payload for user traffic.
Control frames (ACK, RTS/CTS, etc.) coordinate medium access.
Action frames are a management subtype family, but the standard classification for probe response in CCNA is management.
Answer: management.

enunciado: What is the maximum bandwidth of a T1 point-to-point connection?
alternativas: 1.544 Mbps
2.048 Mbps
34.368 Mbps
43.7 Mbps
explicacao_profunda:
A T1 (DS1) circuit provides 1.544 Mbps of bandwidth in North American digital hierarchy.
2.048 Mbps is E1, not T1.
34.368 Mbps is in the E3 range, not T1.
43.7 Mbps is not the T1 rate.
Maximum T1 bandwidth among the options is 1.544 Mbps.

enunciado: What is a characteristic of cloud-based network topology?
alternativas: onsite network services are provided with physical Layer 2 and Layer 3 components
wireless connections provide the sole access method to services
physical workstations are configured to share resources
services are provided by a public, private, or hybrid deployment
explicacao_profunda:
Cloud services are delivered via public, private, or hybrid cloud deployment models rather than solely on-premises physical L2/L3 gear for those services.
On-prem physical L2/L3 describes traditional campus/data center, not the defining cloud topology characteristic.
Wireless-only access is not required for cloud.
Workstation resource sharing is peer-to-peer/file-share thinking, not cloud topology.
Correct: public/private/hybrid service deployment.

enunciado: Which network action occurs within the data plane?
alternativas: reply to an incoming ICMP echo request
make a configuration change from an incoming NETCONF RPC
run routing protocols (OSPF, EIGRP, RIP, BGP)
compare the destination IP address to the IP routing table
explicacao_profunda:
Data-plane forwarding looks up the destination (FIB/CEF/routing table information used for forwarding) and switches the packet to the next hop/interface.
ICMP echo replies are often handled by the control/management processing path depending on platform, and are not the best pure data-plane example vs table lookup forwarding.
NETCONF configuration is management plane.
Running routing protocols is control plane.
The clearest data-plane action listed is comparing the destination IP to the forwarding/routing information to forward the packet.

enunciado: What are network endpoints?
alternativas: support inter-VLAN connectivity
a threat to the network if they are compromised
act as routers to connect a user to the service provider network
enforce policies for campus-wide traffic going to the Internet
explicacao_profunda:
Endpoints (PCs, phones, IoT, servers) are where users and applications live; if compromised they become a major threat vector (malware, lateral movement).
Inter-VLAN connectivity is a router/L3-switch function.
Connecting users to SP is CPE/edge routing, not the definition of endpoints.
Campus Internet policy enforcement is typically fifirewall/edge security devices.
Among the options, recognizing endpoints as threats when compromised matches security-focused CCNA wording.

enunciado: Why was the RFC 1918 address space defined?
alternativas: conserve public IPv4 addressing
support the NAT protocol
preserve public IPv6 address space
reduce instances of overlapping IP addresses
explicacao_profunda:
RFC 1918 defines private IPv4 ranges so organizations can number internal hosts without consuming unique public IPv4 addresses, conserving the public pool.
NAT is a related technology often used with private addresses, but RFC 1918’s primary stated purpose is private addressing / conservation, not “to support NAT” as a protocol dependency.
It does not address IPv6 public space.
Private space can still overlap between organizations; reducing overlap is not the main design goal versus conservation.
Answer: conserve public IPv4 addressing.

enunciado: Which type of organization should use a collapsed-core architecture?
alternativas: small and needs to reduce networking costs
large and must minimize downtime when hardware fails
large and requires a flexible, scalable network design
currently small but is expected to grow dramatically in the near future
explicacao_profunda:
Collapsed-core (two-tier) reduces device count and cost by combining core and distribution — suitable for smaller networks with limited scale needs.
Large networks needing high availability and scale typically keep a three-tier design with clearer failure domains.
Explosive growth expectations often argue against over-collapsing the core long-term.
Best fit: small organization reducing networking costs.

enunciado: A network administrator is setting up a new IPv6 network using the 64-bit address 2001:0EB8:00C1:2200:0001:0000:0000:0331/64. To simplify the configuration, the administrator has decided to compress the address. Which IP address must the administrator configure?
explicacao_profunda:
Start from 2001:0EB8:00C1:2200:0001:0000:0000:0331/64.
Drop leading zeros: 2001:EB8:C1:2200:1:0:0:331.
Compress the longest zero run (two hextets) to :: → 2001:EB8:C1:2200:1::331/64.
Option A wrongly shortens 2200 to 22.
Option B corrupts 2001 into 21.
Option C leaves an explicit 0000 and does not use :: correctly for the double-zero field pair.
Correct compressed form is option D.

enunciado: What is an appropriate use for private IPv4 addressing?
alternativas: to allow hosts inside to communicate in both directions with hosts outside the organization
on internal hosts that stream data solely to external resources
on the public-facing interface of a fifirewall
on hosts that communicate only with other internal hosts
explicacao_profunda:
Private IPv4 addresses are appropriate on internal-only hosts that do not need unique public addressing.
Bidirectional communication with arbitrary Internet hosts requires public addressing or NAT/proxy designs — private alone is insufficient as “the” use case for that goal.
Public-facing fifirewall interfaces typically use public (or provider) addresses.
Streaming solely to external resources usually still needs NAT/public path; the clean textbook use is internal-to-internal communication.
Answer: hosts that communicate only with other internal hosts.

enunciado: What is a similarity between 1000BASE-LX and 1000BASE-T standards?
alternativas: Both use the same data-link header and trailer formats.
Both cable types support RJ-45 connectors.
Both support up to 550 meters between nodes.
Both cable types support LR connectors.
explicacao_profunda:
1000BASE-T (copper) and 1000BASE-LX (fiber) differ in physical media but both carry Ethernet frames with the same IEEE 802.3 data-link framing (header/trailer structure) at 1 Gbps.
RJ-45 is for copper, not LX fiber.
Distance and connector types differ between copper and single-mode/multimode LX optics.
The shared property is Ethernet data-link framing.

enunciado: Which function forwards frames to ports that have a matching destination MAC address?
alternativas: frame flflooding
frame filtering
frame pushing
frame switching
explicacao_profunda:
When the destination MAC is known, a switch performs frame switching/forwarding out the learned port.
flflooding is used for unknown unicast/broadcast/multicast behaviors (send out other ports), not selective known-unicast delivery.
Filtering drops frames (e.g., same-segment decisions / security), not the positive act of forwarding to the match port.
“Frame pushing” is not standard switching terminology here.
Correct function name: frame switching.

enunciado: Which type of IPv6 address is similar to a unicast address but is assigned to multiple devices on the same network at the same time?
alternativas: global unicast address
link-local address
anycast address
multicast address
explicacao_profunda:
Anycast uses a unicast-form address assigned to multiple interfaces; packets go to the “nearest” node per routing.
Global and link-local unicast identify a single interface (per node) in normal use.
Multicast delivers to all members of a group, which is a different model than anycast’s one-nearest delivery.
The description matches anycast.

enunciado: What is a characteristic of private IPv4 addressing?
alternativas: composed of up to 65,536 available addresses
issued by IANA in conjunction with an autonomous system number
used without trafficking or registration
traverse the Internet when an outbound ACL is applied
explicacao_profunda:
Private addresses (RFC 1918) can be used internally without registration/trafficking with a public registry for each host.
The private space is far larger than 65,536 addresses across 10/8, 172.16/12, and 192.168/16.
IANA does not issue private blocks with AS numbers the way public PI/PA space works.
Private addresses do not freely traverse the public Internet merely because an ACL is applied; NAT or similar is required for Internet reachability.
Characteristic: used without trafficking or registration.

enunciado: What is the function of a controller in controller-based networking?
alternativas: It serves as the centralized management point of an SDN architecture
It is a pair of core routers that maintain all routing decisions for a campus
It centralizes the data plane for the network
It is the card on a core router that maintains all routing decisions for a campus.
explicacao_profunda:
In controller-based / SDN architectures, the controller centralizes control/management functions and programs network devices.
It does not mean two campus core routers by definition.
The data plane remains distributed on the forwarding devices; the controller does not usually “centralize the data plane.”
It is not merely a line card on a core router.
Function: centralized management/control point of SDN.

enunciado: How do TCP and UDP fit into a query-response model?
alternativas: TCP avoids using sequencing and UDP avoids using acknowledgments
TCP establishes a connection prior to sending data, and UDP sends immediately
TCP encourages out-of-order packet delivery, and UDP prevents re-ordering
TCP uses error detection for packets, and UDP uses error recovery.
explicacao_profunda:
In client/server query-response apps, TCP pays the connection-setup cost before data; UDP can send the request/response datagrams immediately without a handshake.
TCP uses sequencing; it does not avoid it.
TCP prefers in-order delivery; UDP does not prevent reordering.
UDP has no transport error recovery; TCP does recovery. Option D reverses the recovery idea.
Best contrast: connection first (TCP) vs send immediately (UDP).

enunciado: What provides centralized control of authentication and roaming in an enterprise network?
alternativas: a lightweight access point
a wireless LAN controller
a fifirewall
a LAN switch
explicacao_profunda:
A WLC centralizes WLAN configuration, security policy, authentication integration, and mobility/roaming control for lightweight APs.
Lightweight APs depend on the WLC for much of that control plane.
fifirewalls and LAN switches are important but are not the enterprise WLAN central brain for AP authentication/roaming.
Answer: wireless LAN controller.

enunciado: Which set of 2.4 GHz nonoverlapping wireless channels is standard in the United States?
alternativas: channels 1, 6, 11, and 14
channels 2, 7, 9, and 11
channels 2, 7, and 11
channels 1, 6, and 11
explicacao_profunda:
US 2.4 GHz WLAN design standard nonoverlapping channels are 1, 6, and 11.
Channel 14 is not used in the US for 802.11.
Other listed mixes include overlapping channels or nonstandard sets.
Answer: 1, 6, and 11.

enunciado: A network engineer is installing an IPv6-only capable device. The client has requested that the device IP address be reachable only from the internal network. Which type of IPv6 address must the engineer assign?
alternativas: IPv4-compatible IPv6 address
unique local address
link-local address
aggregatable global address
explicacao_profunda:
Unique local addresses (ULA, fc00::/7 / fd00::/8) are for internal site addressing and are not globally routable on the Internet — matching “reachable only from the internal network.”
Link-local is only same-link, not site-wide internal reachability.
Global unicast is Internet-routable by design.
IPv4-compatible IPv6 addresses are obsolete and not the internal-only solution.
CORRECTED from source index 2 (link-local) to index 1 (unique local): link-local cannot serve internal multi-hop LAN/site reachability.

enunciado: What is a requirement for nonoverlapping Wi-Fi channels?
alternativas: different security settings
discontinuous frequency ranges
unique SSIDs
different transmission speeds
explicacao_profunda:
Nonoverlapping channels occupy frequency ranges that do not significantly overlap in spectrum (e.g., 1/6/11 in 2.4 GHz).
Security settings and SSIDs can be identical across APs; that does not define nonoverlap.
Data rates do not define channel overlap.
Requirement: discontinuous (nonoverlapping) frequency ranges.

enunciado: A network engineer must implement an IPv6 configuration on the vlan 2000 interface to create a routable locally-unique unicast address that is blocked from being advertised to the internet. Which configuration must the engineer apply?
alternativas:
interface vlan 2000
ipv6 address ff00:0000:aaaa::1234:2343/64

interface vlan 2000
ipv6 address fd00::1234:2343/64

interface vlan 2000
ipv6 address fe80:0000:aaaa::1234:2343/64

interface vlan 2000
ipv6 address fc00:0000:aaaa::a15d:1234:2343:8aca/64
explicacao_profunda:
Need a unique local unicast (ULA): fc00::/7, with locally assigned addresses using fd00::/8 in practice.
ff00::/8 is multicast, not a host unicast ULA.
fe80::/10 is link-local, not site-routable ULA across the enterprise the same way.
fd00::1234:2343/64 is a clear ULA configuration.
fc00::/8 is reserved in RFC 4193 for future definition; operational ULA is fd00::/8. Source key selected fc00… (index 3); we correct to fd00 (index 1) as the standards-correct ULA assignment.

enunciado: When a switch receives a frame for a known destination MAC address, how is the frame handled?
alternativas: flooded to all ports except the one from which it originated
forwarded to the first available port
sent to the port identified for the known MAC address
broadcast to all ports
explicacao_profunda:
Known unicast: switch consults the MAC address table and forwards out only the port associated with that destination MAC.
flflooding is for unknown unicast (and similar cases), not known entries.
“First available port” is not how MAC learning works.
Broadcast is for broadcast destination MAC, not known unicast.
Answer: sent to the learned port.

enunciado: What is the collapsed layer in collapsed core architectures?
alternativas: Core and distribution
access and WAN
distribution and access
core and WAN
explicacao_profunda:
Collapsed-core merges the core and distribution layers into one tier while access remains separate (two-tier campus).
Access+WAN or core+WAN are not the standard collapsed pair name.
Distribution+access collapse would remove the user edge separation differently and is not the usual “collapsed core” term.
Answer: core and distribution.

enunciado: What is a characteristic of a SOHO network?
alternativas: includes at least three tiers of devices to provide load balancing and redundancy
connects each switch to every other switch in the network
enables multiple users to share a single broadband connection
provides high throughput access for 1000 or more users
explicacao_profunda:
SOHO networks typically share one broadband Internet link among a few users/devices.
Three-tier redundant designs and 1000+ user campuses are enterprise scale.
Full mesh of all switches is not a SOHO characteristic.
Answer: multiple users share a single broadband connection.

enunciado: What is the role of disaggregation in controller-based networking?
alternativas: It divides the control-plane and data-plane functions.
It streamlines traffic handling by assigning individual devices to perform either Layer 2 or Layer 3 functions
It summarizes the routes between the core and distribution layers of the network topology
It enables a network topology to quickly adjust from a ring network to a star network
explicacao_profunda:
Disaggregation in SDN/controller models separates (disaggregates) control-plane decision making from data-plane forwarding elements.
It is not primarily about forcing devices to be only L2 or only L3.
Route summarization and ring-to-star conversion are unrelated definitions.
Role: divide control-plane and data-plane functions.

enunciado: What is a function performed by a web server?
alternativas: send and retrieve email from client devices
securely store files for FTP access
authenticate and authorize a user's identity
provide an application that is transmitted over HTTP
explicacao_profunda:
Web servers deliver HTTP/HTTPS application content to clients.
Email send/retrieve is mail server (SMTP/IMAP/POP) roles.
FTP storage is an FTP server function.
AAA may be integrated but is not the defining web server function among these choices.
Answer: provide an application transmitted over HTTP.

enunciado: Which protocol uses SSL?
alternativas: SSH
HTTPS
HTTP
Telnet
explicacao_profunda:
HTTPS is HTTP over TLS/SSL for encrypted web transport.
SSH uses its own binary protocol and algorithms, not classic SSL as the answer.
HTTP is cleartext.
Telnet is cleartext remote access.
Answer: HTTPS.

enunciado: Which PoE mode enables powered-device detection and guarantees power when the device is detected?
alternativas: auto
static
dynamic
active
explicacao_profunda:
On Cisco switches, power inline auto (auto mode) performs PD discovery/classification and supplies power when a valid powered device is detected, up to available budget.
Static mode pre-allocates a configured wattage and is less about flexible detection-only behavior.
“Dynamic” and “active” are not the standard pair of interface PoE modes taught as auto vs static in CCNA-style IOS.
Answer: auto.

enunciado: How is RFC 1918 addressing used in a network?
alternativas: They are used to access the Internet from the internal network without conversion.
They are used in place of public addresses for increased security.
They are used with NAT to preserve public IPv4 addresses.
They are used by Internet Service Providers to route over the Internet.
explicacao_profunda:
Private RFC 1918 addresses are commonly combined with NAT so many internal hosts share scarce public IPv4 addresses.
They cannot access the global Internet without translation/proxy of some form.
Security is improved operationally by hiding topology, but the primary exam association is address preservation via NAT.
ISPs do not route RFC 1918 as global Internet destinations.
Answer: used with NAT to preserve public IPv4 addresses.

enunciado: Which WAN topology has the highest degree of reliability?
alternativas: point-to-point
router-on-a-stick
full mesh
hub-and-spoke
explicacao_profunda:
Full mesh provides multiple alternate paths between sites, yielding the highest redundancy/reliability among common WAN topologies listed.
Point-to-point is simple but single path per link pair.
Hub-and-spoke depends on the hub and has limited alternate paths.
Router-on-a-stick is a LAN inter-VLAN method, not a WAN reliability topology.
Answer: full mesh.

enunciado: What causes a port to be placed in the err-disabled state?
alternativas: nothing plugged into the port
link flapping
latency
shutdown command issued on the port
explicacao_profunda:
Link flapping can trigger err-disable (link-flap) when the interface transitions up/down too frequently.
An empty port is simply down/notconnect, not err-disabled.
Latency does not by itself err-disable a port.
shutdown is administratively down, a different state than err-disabled.
Answer: link flapping.

enunciado: A network engineer must configure an interface with IP address 10.10.10.145 and a subnet mask equivalent to 11111111.11111111.11111111.11111000. Which subnet mask must the engineer use?
explicacao_profunda:
Binary mask …11111000 has five zeros in the last octet → 8−5=3 host bits → /29 (255.255.255.248).
/30 is …11111100 (2 host bits).
/28 is …11110000 (4 host bits).
/27 is …11100000 (5 host bits).
The given pattern is /29.

enunciado: Which property is shared by 10GBASE-SR and 10GBASE-LR interfaces?
alternativas: Both use the single-mode fiber type.
Both require UTP cable media for transmission.
Both require fiber cable media for transmission.
Both use the multimode fiber type.
explicacao_profunda:
Both 10GBASE-SR and 10GBASE-LR are optical Ethernet PHYs requiring fiber media.
SR is multimode; LR is single-mode — they do not share the same fiber type.
Neither is UTP-based like 10GBASE-T.
Shared property: fiber media.

enunciado: Which device permits or denies network traffic based on a set of rules?
alternativas: switch
fifirewall
wireless controller
access point
explicacao_profunda:
fifirewalls enforce permit/deny policy using rules (ACLs, stateful policies).
Switches primarily forward frames (though ACLs may exist, the device role named here is fifirewall).
WLC and AP focus on wireless attachment/policy, not the general packet filter definition.
Answer: fifirewall.

enunciado: What is the role of a fifirewall in an enterprise network?
alternativas: determines which packets are allowed to cross from unsecured to secured networks
processes unauthorized packets and allows passage to less secure segments of the network
forwards packets based on stateless packet inspection
explicitly denies all packets from entering an administrative domain
explicacao_profunda:
fifirewalls control traffic between trust zones, deciding what may pass from less-trusted to more-trusted networks (and vice versa per policy).
Deliberately allowing unauthorized packets is the opposite of the role.
Many enterprise fifirewalls are stateful, not only stateless.
They do not blindly deny all traffic; they apply policy.
Answer: determine which packets may cross between unsecured and secured networks.

enunciado: Which action is taken by a switch port enabled for PoE power classification override?
alternativas: As power usage on a PoE switch port is checked, data flow to the connected device is temporarily paused
When a powered device begins drawing power from a PoE switch port, a syslog message is generated
If a switch determines that a device is using less than the minimum configured power, it assumes the device has failed and disconnects it
Should a monitored port exceed the maximum administrative value for power, the port is shut down and err-disabled
explicacao_profunda:
With PoE policing/classification override behaviors on Cisco platforms, exceeding the configured maximum power can err-disable/shut the port to protect the budget and device.
Pausing all data while checking power is not the described override action.
Syslog on power-draw start is not the defining override action.
Disconnecting for drawing less than minimum is not the standard description.
Answer: exceed max administrative power → shut/err-disabled.

enunciado: What is a function of spine-and-leaf architecture?
alternativas: Offers predictable latency of the traffic path between end devices.
Exclusively sends multicast traffic between servers that are directly connected to the spine.
Mitigates oversubscription by adding a layer of leaf switches.
Limits payload size of traffic within the leaf layer.
explicacao_profunda:
Equal hop counts leaf–spine–leaf provide predictable latency/bandwidth characteristics for east-west traffic.
Multicast is not exclusively server-to-spine only by definition of the architecture.
Adding leaves addresses scale-out of endpoints; the predictability of path length is the key function listed correctly in A.
Payload size limiting is not a spine-leaf function.
Answer: predictable latency path between end devices.

enunciado: Which action is taken by the data plane within a network device?
alternativas: Constructs a routing table based on a routing protocol.
Forwards traffic to the next hop.
Looks up an egress interface in the forwarding information base.
Provides CLI access to the network device.
explicacao_profunda:
Data plane forwards user traffic toward the next hop/egress based on forwarding tables.
Building routing tables is control plane.
FIB lookup is part of forwarding; many keys accept “forwards to next hop” as the data-plane action. Source index is 1.
CLI access is management plane.
Keep source answer: forwards traffic to the next hop (index 1). Note option C is also data-plane-related; exam key prioritizes B.

enunciado: What is the function of the control plane?
alternativas: It exchanges routing table information.
It provides CLI access to the network device.
It looks up an egress interface in the forwarding information base.
It forwards traffic to the next hop.
explicacao_profunda:
Control plane runs protocols that build and exchange routing/forwarding information (e.g., OSPF/EIGRP/BGP).
CLI is management plane.
FIB lookup and forwarding are data plane.
Answer: exchanges routing table information.

enunciado: Which cable/media choices support higher multi-gigabit rates (about 2.5–5 Gbps) commonly needed when connecting an access point to a switch/WLC path? (Cleaned from broken Choose-two OCR)
alternativas: Cat 5e (multi-gigabit capable on supporting switch ports)
1000BASE-LX/LH fiber only (max 1 Gbps optical Ethernet standard as named)
Cat 3 cabling
Cat 5 (non-e) as the preferred modern AP uplink
explicacao_profunda:
Multi-gigabit (2.5G/5G) AP uplinks on copper typically require at least Cat 5e (often Cat 6) and mGig switch ports; 10GBASE-T also needs quality copper.
OCR source mixed Choose-two options (10GBASE-T, Cat 5e, etc.). Cleaned to four coherent choices.
1000BASE-LX/LH is a 1G optical standard name, not the multi-gig copper answer.
Cat 3 cannot sustain multi-gig AP uplinks.
Cat 5 (non-e) is below modern multi-gig recommendations versus Cat 5e/6.
Best cleaned answer: Cat 5e multi-gig capable path (index 0). Original source_rc=0 mapped to first listed tech after cleanup.

enunciado: What is a benefit for external users who consume public cloud resources?
alternativas: Implemented over a dedicated WAN
All hosted on physical servers
Accessed over the Internet
Located in the same data center as the users
explicacao_profunda:
Public cloud resources are consumed by external users primarily over the Internet.
Dedicated WAN is more private connectivity (e.g., Direct Connect/MPLS), not the general public-cloud user benefit statement.
Cloud abstrafficts whether physical servers are visible to the consumer.
Users are not necessarily in the same DC as the cloud provider region.
Answer: accessed over the Internet.

enunciado: An engineer must update the configuration on two PCs in two different subnets to communicate locally with each other. One PC is configured with IP address 192.168.25.128/25 and the other with 192.168.25.100/25. Which network mask must the engineer configure on both PCs to enable the communication?
explicacao_profunda:
With /25, 192.168.25.0–127 and 192.168.25.128–255 are different subnets. .100 and .128 fall in different halves, so they are not local to each other.
Using 255.255.255.0 (/24) places both addresses in 192.168.25.0/24 so they communicate as on-link peers (same L2 assumed).
/28,/27,/30 keep them separated or create tiny subnets that still won't cover both.
Answer: 255.255.255.0.

enunciado: Which key function is provided by the data plane?
alternativas: Originating packets
Exchanging routing table data
Making routing decisions
Forwarding traffic to the next hop
explicacao_profunda:
Data plane forwards transit traffic to the next hop/egress interface.
Exchanging routing data and making control decisions are control plane.
“Originating packets” is ambiguous (could be local process) and not the key data-plane definition.
Answer: forwarding traffic to the next hop.

enunciado: When should an engineer implement a collapsed-core architecture?
alternativas: Only when using VSS technology
For small networks with minimal need for growth
For large networks that are connected to multiple remote sites
The access and distribution layers must be on the same device
explicacao_profunda:
Collapsed core suits small networks that do not need independent core/distribution scaling.
VSS is optional technology, not a requirement for collapsed core.
Large multi-site networks usually keep hierarchical modularity.
Access and distribution on the same device is not the definition (core+distribution collapse).
Answer: small networks with minimal growth need.

enunciado: A client experiences slow throughput from a server that is directly connected to the core switch in a data center. A network engineer finds minimal latency on connections to the server, but data transfers are unreliable, and the output of the show interfaces counters errors command shows a high FCS-Err count on the interface that is connected to the server. What is the cause of the throughput issue?
alternativas: a physical cable fault
a speed mismatch
high bandwidth usage
a cable that is too long
explicacao_profunda:
High FCS/CRC errors with unreliable transfers and low latency strongly indicate Layer-1 problems such as bad cable, connectors, or NIC/phy issues.
Speed mismatch more often shows duplex/collision patterns or link issues, but FCS with “minimal latency” points to corruption on the wire.
High bandwidth usage causes congestion drops/latency, not typically interface FCS error counters.
Excessive length can cause errors, but the standard best answer among these for FCS-Err is physical cable fault.
Answer: a physical cable fault.

enunciado: What is the difference between 1000BASE-LX/LH and 1000BASE-ZX interfaces?
alternativas: 1000BASE-LX/LH interoperates with multimode and single-mode fiber, and 1000BASE-ZX needs a conditioning patch cable with multimode.
1000BASE-ZX interoperates with dual-rate 100M/1G 10Km SFP over multimode fiber, and 1000BASE-LX/LH supports only single-rate
1000BASE-ZX is supported on links up to 1000 km, and 1000BASE-LX/LH operates over links up to 70 km
1000BASE-LX/LH is supported on links up to 10 km, and 1000BASE-ZX operates over links up to 70 km
explicacao_profunda:
1000BASE-LX/LH is commonly specified around up to ~10 km on single-mode (and shorter on multimode with conditions).
1000BASE-ZX is a long-reach single-mode optic often rated around ~70 km.
1000 km is unrealistic for ZX in this comparison.
The distance contrast in option D matches typical CCNA/vendor comparison items.
Answer: LX/LH ~10 km vs ZX ~70 km.

enunciado: Which concern is addressed with the use of private IPv4 addressing?
alternativas: Lack of routing protocol support for CIDR and VLSM
Lack of security protocols at the network perimeter
Lack of available TCP/UDP ports per IPv4 address
Lack of available publicly routable unique IPv4 addresses
explicacao_profunda:
Private addressing (with NAT) addresses the scarcity of publicly routable unique IPv4 addresses.
Routing protocols support CIDR/VLSM independently of RFC 1918.
Security protocols at the perimeter are a different concern.
TCP/UDP port counts per IP are not why RFC 1918 exists (OCR “IPv5” cleaned to IPv4).
Answer: lack of available publicly routable unique IPv4 addresses.

enunciado: What is the path for traffic sent from one user workstation to another workstation on a separate switch in a three-tier architecture model?
alternativas: access → core → access
access → distribution → distribution → access
access → core → distribution → access
access → distribution → core → distribution → access
explicacao_profunda:
In classic three-tier campus, user switches are access. Traffic between access switches goes up to distribution, across the core if needed, to the remote distribution, then down to the remote access switch.
Skipping distribution or core violates the hierarchical model path for inter-switch user traffic across the campus.
Answer: access → distribution → core → distribution → access.

enunciado: What is the difference between IPv6 unicast and anycast addressing?
alternativas: An individual IPv6 unicast address is supported on a single interface on one node, but an IPv6 anycast address is assigned to a group of interfaces on multiple nodes.
IPv6 anycast nodes must be explicitly configured to recognize the anycast address, but IPv6 unicast nodes require no special configuration.
IPv6 unicast nodes must be explicitly configured to recognize the unicast address, but IPv6 anycast nodes require no special configuration.
Unlike an IPv6 anycast address, an IPv6 unicast address is assigned to a group of interfaces on multiple nodes.
explicacao_profunda:
Unicast identifies one interface; anycast reuses a unicast-form address on multiple nodes so routing delivers to the nearest member.
Option D reverses the definitions.
Options B/C oversimplify configuration requirements incorrectly relative to the core definition.
Best difference: unicast one interface vs anycast many nodes.

enunciado: Which WAN topology provides a combination of simplicity, quality, and availability?
alternativas: partial mesh
full mesh
point-to-point
hub-and-spoke
explicacao_profunda:
Point-to-point leased-style links are simple to understand/configure and can offer predictable quality/availability on that circuit.
Full mesh maximizes availability but is complex/costly.
Hub-and-spoke is simple but hub-centric availability risk.
Partial mesh is a compromise, not the option keyed as simplest quality/availability combo here.
Source answer: point-to-point.

enunciado: How are the switches in a spine-and-leaf topology interconnected?
alternativas: Each leaf switch is connected to one of the spine switches
Each leaf switch is connected to each spine switch.
Each leaf switch is connected to two spine switches, making a loop.
Each leaf switch is connected to a central leaf switch, then uplinked to a core spine switch.
explicacao_profunda:
Canonical spine-and-leaf: every leaf connects to every spine (full bipartite connectivity).
Connecting each leaf to only one spine loses fabric properties.
“Two spines making a loop” misstates L3 ECMP fabric design as STP loops.
Leaf-to-leaf hierarchy is not spine-leaf.
Answer: each leaf to each spine.

enunciado: What is the primary effect of the spanning-tree portfast command?
alternativas: It immediately enables the port in the listening state.
It immediately puts the port into the forwarding state when the link comes up.
It enables BPDU messages.
It minimizes spanning-tree convergence time on edge ports.
explicacao_profunda:
PortFast skips the listening/learning delay on edge ports so hosts get connectivity quickly, minimizing STP transition delay for those ports (faster edge convergence).
It should put the port into forwarding quickly, not listening.
It does not “enable BPDU messages” as its primary purpose (BPDUs still exist; BPDU Guard is a related edge protection).
Source index 3 emphasizes minimized STP convergence time on the edge; option B is also directionally true after OCR fix — keep source rc=3 as the keyed primary effect statement.

enunciado: A network engineer is asked to configure VLANs 2, 3, and 4 for a new implementation. Some ports must be assigned to the new VLANs withunused ports remaining. Which action should be taken for the unused ports?
alternativas: configure in a nondefault native VLAN
configure ports in the native VLAN
configure ports in a black hole VLAN
configure ports as access ports
explicacao_profunda: Unused switch ports should be placed in a black-hole/unused VLAN (and preferably shut down) so they are not left in the default native/user VLAN where they can be abused. Access mode alone without isolation is incomplete; putting them in native VLAN or leaving defaults is insecure.

enunciado: What mechanism carries multicast traffic between remote sites and supports encryption?
alternativas: ISATAP
IPsec over ISATAP
GRE
GRE over IPsec
explicacao_profunda: GRE over IPsec carries multicast (and other) traffic between sites inside a GRE tunnel while IPsec provides encryption. Plain GRE has no crypto. ISATAP is IPv6 transition, not the standard site multicast+encryption design.

enunciado: Which action implements physical access control as part of the security program of an organization?
alternativas: setting up IP cameras to monitor key infrastructure
configuring a password for the console port
backing up syslogs at a remote location
configuring enable passwords on network devices
explicacao_profunda: Physical access control protects facilities and equipment via cameras, badges, locks. Console/enable passwords are logical/device access controls, not physical program controls.

enunciado: Which eld within the access-request packet is encrypted by RADIUS?
alternativas: authorized services
password
authenticator
username
explicacao_profunda: RADIUS encrypts only the password (and secrets) in Access-Request; username and much of the packet are not fully encrypted like TACACS+ body encryption.

enunciado: A Cisco engineer is configuring a factory-default router with these three passwords:✑ The user EXEC password for console access is p4ssw0rd1.✑ The user EXEC password for Telnet access is s3cr3t2.✑ The password for privileged EXEC mode is priv4t3p4ss.Which command sequence must the engineer configure?
alternativas:
enable secret priv4t3p4ss
!
line con 0
 password p4ssw0rd1
!
line vty 0 15
 password s3cr3t2

enable secret priv4t3p4ss
!
line con 0
 password p4ssw0rd1
 login
!
line vty 0 15
 password s3cr3t2
 login

enable secret priv4t3p4ss
!
line con 0
 password login p4ssw0rd1
!
line vty 0 15
 password login s3cr3t2
 login

enable secret privilege 15 priv4t3p4ss
!
line con 0
 password p4ssw0rd1
 login
!
line vty 0 15
 password s3cr3t2
 login
explicacao_profunda: Factory-default hardening needs enable secret for privileged EXEC, and password + login on console and VTY for user EXEC. Invalid 'enable secret privilege 15' syntax is wrong; missing login leaves lines without authentication.

enunciado: What is a function of Opportunistic Wireless Encryption in an environment?
alternativas: provide authentication
protect traffic on open networks
offer compression
increase security by using a WEP connection
explicacao_profunda: OWE (Opportunistic Wireless Encryption) encrypts traffic on open SSIDs without a PSK, improving privacy on open networks. It is not primarily an authentication framework like 802.1X, nor WEP.

enunciado: Which encryption method is used by WPA3?
alternativas: TKIP
AES
SAE
PSK
explicacao_profunda: WPA3 personal mode uses SAE (Simultaneous Authentication of Equals). AES is the cipher suite family; TKIP/PSK refer to older WPA/WPA2 concepts.

enunciado: Which type of traffic is sent with pure IPsec?
alternativas: multicast traffic from a server at one site to hosts at another location
broadcast packets from a switch that is attempting to locate a MAC address at one of several remote sites
unicast messages from a host at a remote site to a server at headquarters
spanning-tree updates between switches that are at two different sites
explicacao_profunda: Native IPsec (without GRE) typically protects unicast IP flows. Multicast/broadcast and STP are not pure IPsec use cases without additional tunneling.

enunciado: How does authentication differ from authorization?
alternativas: Authentication is used to record what resource a user accesses, and authorization is used to determine what resources a user can access.
Authentication verifies the identity of a person accessing a network, and authorization determines what resource a user can access.
Authentication is used to determine what resources a user is allowed to access, and authorization is used to traffick what equipment isallowed access to the network.
Authentication is used to verify a person's identity, and authorization is used to create syslog messages for logins.
explicacao_profunda: Authentication verifies identity; authorization determines permitted resources; accounting records activity. Options that swap authN/authZ or describe accounting are incorrect.

enunciado: An engineer has configured the domain name, user name, and password on the local router. What is the next step to complete the configurationfor a Secure Shell access RSA key?
alternativas: crypto key import rsa pem
crypto key generate rsa
crypto key zeroize rsa
crypto key pubkey-chain rsa
explicacao_profunda: After hostname/domain/user setup, generate RSA keys with crypto key generate rsa for SSH. Import/zeroize/pubkey-chain are other key operations, not the next enable step.

enunciado: Which wireless security protocol relies on Perfect Forward Secrecy?
alternativas: WEP
WPA2
WPA
WPA3
explicacao_profunda: WPA3 provides forward secrecy (SAE/PFS properties). WEP/WPA/WPA2 do not rely on PFS the same way WPA3 does.

enunciado: Which characteristic differentiates the concept of authentication from authorization and accounting?
alternativas: consumption-based billing
identity verication
user-activity logging
service limitations
explicacao_profunda: Authentication’s distinguishing characteristic is identity verification. Billing is accounting-ish commercial; logging is accounting; service limits are authorization.

enunciado: What is a function of Cisco Advanced Malware Protection for a Next-Generation IPS?
alternativas: inspecting specific fifiles and file types for malware
authorizing potentially compromised wireless traffic
authenticating end users
URL fifiltering
explicacao_profunda: AMP for NGFW/NGIPS inspects files/file types for malware. It is not primarily user auth, wireless authorization, or simple URL filtering alone.

enunciado: What is a feature of WPA?
alternativas: TKIP/MIC encryption
small Wi-Fi application
preshared key
802.1x authentication
explicacao_profunda: Original WPA introduced TKIP/MIC to improve on WEP. PSK and 802.1X are authentication modes that exist across generations; TKIP/MIC is the classic WPA feature named here.

enunciado: How does WPA3 improve security?
alternativas: It uses SAE for authentication.
It uses RC4 for encryption.
It uses TKIP for encryption.
It uses a 4-way handshake for authentication.
explicacao_profunda: WPA3 improves security using SAE instead of the WPA2 PSK 4-way weaknesses. RC4/TKIP are legacy and weaker.

enunciado: What is a function of a Next-Generation IPS?
alternativas: correlates user activity with network events
serves as a controller within a controller-based network
integrates with a RADIUS server to enforce Layer 2 device authentication rufifiles
makes forwarding decisions based on learned MAC addresses
explicacao_profunda: NGIPS correlates users/applications with network events for better threat context. It is not a WLAN controller, pure RADIUS authenticator, or L2 MAC switch.

enunciado: Which IPsec transport mode encrypts the IP header and the payload?
alternativas: pipe
transport
control
tunnel
explicacao_profunda: IPsec tunnel mode protects the original IP header and payload (new outer header). Transport mode encrypts primarily the payload, leaving the original IP header in the clear (with ESP).

enunciado: Which device separates networks by security domains?
alternativas: intrusion protection system
fifirewall
wireless controller
access point
explicacao_profunda: fifirewalls separate security domains/zones with policy. IPS detects/prevents threats; WLC/AP are wireless infrastructure.

enunciado: How are VLAN hopping attacks mitigated?
alternativas: manually implement trunk ports and disable DTP
configure extended VLANs
activate all ports and place in the default VLAN
enable dynamic ARP inspection
explicacao_profunda: Mitigate VLAN hopping by hard-setting trunks, disabling DTP, and careful native VLAN design. DAI mitigates ARP spoofing; activating all ports in default VLAN worsens risk.

enunciado: Which enhancements were implemented as part of WPA3?
alternativas: Forward secrecy and SAE in personal mode for secure initial key exchange
802.1x authentication and AES-128 encryption
AES-64 in personal mode and AES-128 in enterprise mode
TKIP encryption improving WEP and per-packet keying
explicacao_profunda: WPA3 adds SAE and forward secrecy in personal mode. TKIP/WEP improvements are older WPA ideas; AES-64 is nonsense.

enunciado: When a site-to-site VPN is configured which IPsec mode provides encapsulation and encryption of the entire original IP packet?
alternativas: IPsec transport mode with AH
IPsec tunnel mode with AH
IPsec transport mode with ESP
IPsec tunnel mode with ESP
explicacao_profunda: Site-to-site VPNs use IPsec tunnel mode with ESP to encapsulate and encrypt the entire original IP packet. Transport mode does not encapsulate the original header the same way; AH provides integrity without ESP confidentiality.

enunciado: In an SDN architecture, which function of a network node is centralized on a controller?
alternativas: Cccreates the IP routing table
Discards a message due fifiltering
Makes a routing decision
Provides protocol access for remote access devices
explicacao_profunda: In SDN, the controller centralizes control-plane decisions (routing/forwarding policy). Data plane still forwards; filtering discard is data-plane action; remote access is management.

enunciado: Which management security profficess is invoked when a user logs in to a network device using their username and password?
alternativas: authentication
auditing
accounting
authorization
explicacao_profunda: Login with username/password invokes authentication. Authorization follows for privileges; accounting/auditing traffick sessions.

enunciado: Which enhancement is implemented in WPA3?
alternativas: employs PKI to identify access points
applies 802.1x authentication
uses TKIP
protects against brute force attacks
explicacao_profunda: WPA3 SAE strengthens resistance to offline brute-force/dictionary attacks on personal networks versus WPA2-PSK.

enunciado: Which port security violation mode allows from valid MAC addresses to pass but blocks traffic from invalid MAC addresses?
alternativas: restrict
shutdown
protect
shutdown VLAN
explicacao_profunda: Port-security protect mode silently drops frames from unknown MACs while allowing known ones; no SNMP/syslog increment like restrict, and no err-disable like shutdown.

enunciado: A customer wants to provide wireless access to contraffictors using a guest portal on Cisco ISE. The portal is also used by employees. A solution is implemented, but contraffictors receive a certificate error when they attempt to access the portal. Employees can access the portal without anyerrors. Which change must be implemented to allow the contraffictors and employees to access the portal?
alternativas: Install an Internal CA signed certificate on the Cisco ISE.
Install a trusted third-party certificate on the Cisco ISE.
Install an internal CA signed certificate on the contraffictor devices.
Install a trusted third-party certificate on the contraffictor devices.
explicacao_profunda: Guest portals need a publicly trusted certificate on ISE so contraffictor browsers do not show cert errors. Internal CA fails on unmanaged contraffictor devices unless the CA is pre-trusted.

enunciado: A network engineer is implementing a corporate SSID for WPA3-Personal security with a PSK. Which encryption cipher must be configured?
alternativas: CCMP128
GCMP256
CCMP256
GCMP128
explicacao_profunda: WPA3-Personal with PSK commonly uses CCMP-128 (AES-CCMP). GCMP-256 is more aligned with WPA3-Enterprise 192-bit mode options, not the basic personal PSK case in this item.

enunciado: An organization has decided to start using cloud-provided services. Which cloud service allows the organization to install its own operatingsystem on a virtual machine?
alternativas: platform-as-a-service
network-as-a-service
software-as-a-service
infrastructure-as-a-service
explicacao_profunda: IaaS provides virtualized compute/storage/network infrastructure the org manages (OS up). SaaS is apps; PaaS is runtime platforms.

enunciado: How do traditional campus device management and Cisco DNA Center device management differ in regards to deployment?
alternativas: Traditional campus device management allows a network to scale more quickly than with Cisco DNA Center device management.
Cisco DNA Center device management can deploy a network more quickly than traditional campus device management.
Cisco DNA Center device management can be implemented at a lower cost than most traditional campus device management options.
Traditional campus device management schemes can typically deploy patches and updates more quickly than Cisco DNA Center devicemanagement.
explicacao_profunda: DNA Center deploys consistent configuration/policy across many devices centrally. Traditional management is often device-by-device CLI.

enunciado: Which purpose does a northbound API serve in a controller-based networking architecture?
alternativas: facilitates communication between the controller and the applications
reports device errors to a controller
generates statistics for network hardware and traffic
communicates between the controller and the physical network hardware
explicacao_profunda: Northbound APIs let applications/orchestration talk to the controller. Southbound talks to network devices.

enunciado: What benefit does controller-based networking provide versus traditional networking?
alternativas: allows configuration and monitoring of the network from one centralized point
provides an added layer of security to protect from DDoS attacks
combines control and data plane functionality on a single device to minimize latency
moves from a two-tier to a three-tier network architecture to provide maximum redundancy
explicacao_profunda: Controller-based networking enables centralized configuration and monitoring versus per-box traditional management. It separates control from data plane rather than combining them on every box only.

enunciado: What is an advantage of Cisco DNA Center versus traditional campus device management?
alternativas: It is designed primarily to provide network assurance.
It supports numerous extensibility options, including cross-domain adapters and third-party SDKs.
It supports high availability for management functions when operating in cluster mode.
It enabfifiles easy autodiscovery of network elements in a browneld deployment.
explicacao_profunda: DNA Center offers broad extensibility (REST APIs, integrations) beyond classic campus managers focused only on discovery/assurance HA.

enunciado: How does Cisco DNA Center gather data from the network?
alternativas: Devices use the call-home protocol to periodically send data to the controller
Devices establish an IPsec tunnel to exchange data with the controller
The Cisco CLI Analyzer tool gathers data from each licensed network device and streams it to the controller
Network devices use different services like SNMP, syslog, and streaming telemetry to send data to the controller
explicacao_profunda: DNA Center collects via SNMP, syslog, NetFlow/telemetry, and device adapters—not a single IPsec call-home-only model.

enunciado: Which statement compares traditional networks and controller-based networks?
alternativas: Only controller-based networks decouple the control plane and the data plane.
Traditional and controller-based networks abstraffict policies from device configurations.
Only traditional networks natively support centralized management.
Only traditional networks offer a centralized control plane.
explicacao_profunda: Controller-based networks explicitly decouple control and data planes; traditional boxes co-locate both. Centralized control is the SDN trait, not traditional-only.

enunciado: What software-defined architecture plane assists network devices with making packet-forwarding decisions by providing Layer 2 reachability andLayer 3 routing information?
alternativas: management plane
control plane
data plane
policy plane
explicacao_profunda: The control plane computes forwarding information used by the data plane. Management is device ops; data plane forwards; policy is higher intent.

enunciado: Which type of API allows SDN controllers to dynamically make changes to the network?
alternativas: northbound API
REST API
SOAP API
southbound API
explicacao_profunda: Southbound APIs let the controller program network devices dynamically. Northbound faces apps; REST/SOAP are styles that can be used either direction depending on design.

enunciado: Which option about JSON is true -
alternativas: uses predefined tags or angle brackets () to delimit markup text
used to describe structured data that includes arrays
used for storing information
similar to HTML, it is more verbose than XML
explicacao_profunda: JSON represents structured data including objects and arrays with key/value syntax. It is less verbose than XML and does not use HTML-like angle-bracket markup as its model.

enunciado: Which option best describes an API?
alternativas: a contraffict that describes how various components communicate and exchange data with each other
an architectural style (versus a protocol) for designing applications
a stateless client-server model
request a certain type of data by specifying the URL path that models the data
explicacao_profunda: An API is a contraffict defining how software components interact. REST is one architectural style; URL paths are usage details of HTTP APIs.

enunciado: Which of the following is the JSON encoding of a dictionary or hash?
alternativas: {"key": "value"}
["key", "value"]
{"key", "value"}
("key": "value")
explicacao_profunda: A JSON object/dictionary is encoded as {"key": "value"}. Arrays use []; tuples/parens are not JSON objects.

enunciado: Which role does a hypervisor provide for each virtual machine in server virtualization?
alternativas: infrastructure-as-a-service
Software-as-a-service
control and distribution of physical resources
services as a hardware controller
explicacao_profunda: The hypervisor allocates and schedules physical CPU, memory, storage, and I/O among VMs. IaaS/SaaS are cloud service models, not the hypervisor’s per-VM role.

enunciado: What is the function of a server?
alternativas: It transmits packets between hosts in the same broadcast domain.
It provides shared applications to end users.
It routes traffic between Layer 3 devices.
It cccreates security zones between trusted and untrusted networks.
explicacao_profunda: Servers provide shared applications/services to clients. Switches forward in a LAN; routers route; fifirewalls zone.

enunciado: Which CRUD operation modies an existing table or view?
alternativas: read
update
replace
create
explicacao_profunda: CRUD Update modifies existing resources/tables/views. Create inserts; Read retrieves; Replace is not the standard CRUD verb name here.

enunciado: In software-defined architectures, which plane is distributed and responsible for traffic forwarding?
alternativas: management plane
policy plane
data plane
control plane
explicacao_profunda: In SDN, the data plane remains distributed on devices for traffic forwarding; control is centralized on the controller.

enunciado: Which configuration management mechanism uses TCP port 22 by default when communicating with managed nodes?
alternativas: Ansible
Python
Puppet
Chef
explicacao_profunda: Ansible connects to managed nodes primarily over SSH (TCP 22). Puppet/Chef commonly use agent/TLS ports; Python is a language.

enunciado: What does an SDN controller use as a communication protocol to relay forwarding changes to a southbound API?
alternativas: Java
REST
OpenFlow
XML
explicacao_profunda: OpenFlow is a classic southbound protocol for an SDN controller to install forwarding entries on switches. REST is often northbound; Java/XML are not the forwarding SB protocol named here.

enunciado: What uses HTTP messages to transfer data to applications residing on different hosts?
alternativas: OpenStack
OpFlex
REST
OpenFlow
explicacao_profunda: REST uses HTTP methods/messages to exchange data between clients and application services on hosts. OpenFlow/OpFlex are SDN southbound; OpenStack is a cloud platform.

enunciado: Which JSON data type is an unordered set of attribute-value pairs?
alternativas: string
array
Boolean
object
explicacao_profunda: A JSON object is an unordered set of name/value pairs. Arrays are ordered lists; string/boolean are primitives.

enunciado: Which protocol is used in Software defined Access (SDA) to provide a tunnel between two edge nodes in different fabrics?
alternativas: Generic Router Encapsulation (GRE)
Virtual Local Area Network (VLAN)
Virtual Extensible LAN (VXLAN)
Point-to-Point Protocol (PPP)
explicacao_profunda: Cisco SD-Access fabric uses VXLAN (with LISP control) to tunnel between edge nodes. GRE/VLAN/PPP are not the SDA fabric data-plane encapsulation.

enunciado: Which plane is centralized by an SDN controller?
alternativas: management-plane
data-plane
services-plane
control-plane
explicacao_profunda: SDN controllers centralize the control plane. Data plane stays on devices; management/services planes are separate concepts.

enunciado: Where is the interface between the control plane and data plane within the software-defined architecture?
alternativas: application layer and the management layer
application layer and the infrastructure layer
control layer and the application layer
control layer and the infrastructure layer
explicacao_profunda: Southbound interface sits between control layer (controller) and infrastructure layer (switches/routers). Northbound is control↔application.

enunciado: Why would a network administrator choose to implement automation in a network environment?
alternativas: To simplify the profficess of maintaining a consistent configuration state across all devices
To centralize device information storage
To implement centralized user account management
To deploy the management plane separately from the rest of the network
explicacao_profunda: Automation reduces configuration drift and makes consistent configs easier to maintain at scale. It is not mainly about splitting management plane alone.

enunciado: In software-defined architecture, which plane handfiles switching for traffic through a Cisco router?
alternativas: control
data
management
application
explicacao_profunda: Packet switching/forwarding through a router is data-plane work. Control plane builds tables; management configures the device.

enunciado: What makes Cisco DNA Center different from traditional network management applications and their management of networks?
alternativas: Its modular design allows the implementation of different versions to meet the specific needs of an organization.
It only supports auto-discovery of network elements in a greeneld deployment.
It omits support high availability of management functions when operating in cluster mode.
It abstrafficts policy from the actual device configuration.
explicacao_profunda: DNA Center abstrafficts intent/policy from per-device CLI configuration, unlike traditional EMS tools that push device-centric configs.

enunciado: Which API is used in controller-based architectures to interact with edge devices?
alternativas: southbound
overlay
northbound
underlay
explicacao_profunda: Southbound APIs interact with edge/infrastructure devices. Northbound faces applications/orchestration.

enunciado: What differentiates device management enabled by Cisco DNA Center from traditional campus device management?
alternativas: CLI-oriented device
centralized
device-by-device hands-on
per-device
explicacao_profunda: DNA Center enables centralized device management versus traditional per-device hands-on CLI.

enunciado: How do servers connect to the network in a virtual environment?
alternativas: a cable connected to a physical switch on the network
wireless to an access point that is physically connected to the network
a virtual switch that links to an access point that is physically connected to the network
a software switch on a hypervisor that is physically connected to the network
explicacao_profunda: VMs connect via a virtual switch in the hypervisor, which uplinks to the physical network. Not purely wireless AP attachment as the general model.

enunciado: What is the function of the controller in a software-defined network?
alternativas: forwarding packets
multicast replication at the hardware level
making routing decisions
fragmenting and reassembling packets
explicacao_profunda: The SDN controller makes control decisions (routing/policy programming). Forwarding/replication/reassembly are data-plane device functions.

enunciado: What is a function of a southbound API?
alternativas: Use orchestration to provision a virtual server configuration from a web server
Automate configuration changes between a server and a switching fabric
Manage flflow control between an SDN controller and a switching fabric
Facilitate the information exchange between an SDN controller and application
explicacao_profunda: Southbound APIs manage flow/control programming between controller and switches. Northbound is controller↔apps.

enunciado: Which script paradigm does Puppet use?
alternativas: recipes and cookbooks
playbooks and rofifiles
strings and marionettes
manifests and modufifiles
explicacao_profunda: Puppet uses manifests and modules. Chef uses recipes/cookbooks; Ansible uses playbooks/roles.

enunciado: Which set of methods is supported with the REST API?
alternativas: GET, PUT, ERASE, CHANGE
GET, POST, MOD, ERASE
GET, PUT, POST, DELETE
GET, POST, ERASE, CHANGE
explicacao_profunda: REST standard methods include GET, PUT, POST, DELETE (and PATCH). ERASE/MOD/CHANGE are not standard REST verbs.

enunciado: Which technology is appropriate for communication between an SDN controller and applications running over the network?
alternativas: Southbound API
REST API
NETCONF
OpenFlow
explicacao_profunda: Communication between SDN controller and applications is northbound, commonly REST. OpenFlow/NETCONF are device-facing southbound styles.

enunciado: What is the function of `off-the-shelf` switches in a controller-based network?
alternativas: setting packet-handling policies
forwarding packets
providing a central view of the deployed network
making routing decisions
explicacao_profunda: In controller-based networks, white-box/off-the-shelf switches focus on forwarding packets under controller programming; policy and routing decisions are centralized.

enunciado: Which REST method updates an object in the Cisco DNA Center Intent API?
alternativas: CHANGE
UPDATE
POST
PUT
explicacao_profunda: HTTP PUT updates/replaces a resource in REST/DNA Intent APIs. POST typically creates; UPDATE/CHANGE are not standard HTTP methods.

enunciado: Which definition describes JWT in regard to REST API security?
alternativas: an encrypted JSON token that is used for authentication
an encrypted JSON token that is used for authorization
an encoded JSON token that is used to securely exchange information
an encoded JSON token that is used for authentication
explicacao_profunda: JWT is an encoded (optionally signed/encrypted) JSON token used to securely exchange claims for authN/authZ between parties—not merely a vague encrypted blob description without the exchange purpose.

enunciado: Which communication interaction takes place when a southbound API is used?
alternativas: between the SDN controller and PCs on the network
between the SDN controller and switches and routers on the network
between the SDN controller and services and applications on the network
between network applications and switches and routers on the network
explicacao_profunda: Southbound API traffic is controller ↔ network devices (switches/routers). Apps use northbound.

enunciado: What is an expected outcome when network management automation is deployed?
alternativas: A distributed management plane must be used.
Complexity increases when new device configurations are added.
Custom applications are needed to configure network devices.
Software upgrades are performed from a central controller.
explicacao_profunda: Automation outcomes include centralized software upgrades and consistent changes from a controller/orchestrator. Complexity should decrease for routine config; custom apps are not always required.

enunciado: Which HTTP status code is returned after a successful REST API request?
explicacao_profunda: HTTP 200 OK indicates successful REST requests. 301 redirect, 404 not found, 500 server error are not success.

enunciado: With REST API, which standard HTTP header tells a server which media type is expected by the client?
alternativas: Accept-Encoding: gzip. deflate
Accept-Patch: text/example; charset=utf-8
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Accept: application/json
explicacao_profunda: Accept header tells the server which media types the client expects (e.g., application/json). Content-Type describes the body being sent.

enunciado: What is the purpose of the Cisco DNA Center controller?
alternativas: to securely manage and deploy network devices
to scan a network and generate a Layer 2 network diagram
to secure physical access to a data center
to provide Layer 3 services to autonomous access points
explicacao_profunda: DNA Center securely manages, provisions, and assures network devices with centralized automation. It is not primarily a physical security system or AP-only L3 service box.

enunciado: Which statement identifies the functionality of virtual machines?
alternativas: Virtualized servers run most efficiently when they are physically connected to a switch that is separate from the hypervisor
The hypervisor can virtualize physical components including CPU, memory, and storage
Each hypervisor can support a single virtual machine and a single software switch
The hypervisor communicates on Layer 3 without the need for additional resources
explicacao_profunda: Hypervisors virtualize CPU, memory, storage, and NICs for multiple VMs. They are not limited to one VM; efficiency does not require a physically separate switch from the host.

enunciado: Which network plane is centralized and manages routing decisions?
alternativas: management plane
data plane
policy plane
control plane
explicacao_profunda: Centralized routing decisions are control-plane functions in SDN. Data plane forwards; management configures; policy is intent layer.

enunciado: What is a benefit of using private IPv4 addressing?
alternativas: Multiple companies can use the same addresses without conflicts.
Direct connectivity is provided to internal hosts from outside an enterprise network.
Communication to the internet is reachable without the use of NAT.
All external hosts are provided with secure communication to the internet.
explicacao_profunda: Private IPv4 lets many organizations reuse RFC1918 space without global uniqueness conflicts. It does not provide direct Internet reachability without NAT/proxy.

enunciado: Which element of a virtualization solution manages virtualized services and enabfiles connections between virtualized services and externalinterfaces?
alternativas: software
network functionality
virtual machine
hardware
explicacao_profunda: Virtual machines are the virtualized compute endpoints; the hypervisor/software stack enables connectivity between VMs and physical resources. The VM is the element hosting virtualized services in this framing.

enunciado: Which group of channels in the 802.11b/g/n/ac/ax 2.4 GHz frequency bands are nonoverlapping channels?
alternativas: channels 1, 5, and 10
channels 1, 6, and 11
channels 1, 5, and 11
channels 1, 6, and 10
explicacao_profunda: In 2.4 GHz, nonoverlapping channels are 1, 6, and 11 (in most regulatory domains).

enunciado: What is a function of Layer 3 switches?
alternativas: They route traffic between devices in different VLANs.
They transmit broadcast traffic when operating in Layer 3 mode exclusively.
They move frames between endpoints limited to IP addresses.
They forward Ethernet frames between VLANs using only MAC addresses,
explicacao_profunda: Layer 3 switches route IP between VLANs/SVIs (inter-VLAN routing). They do not forward between VLANs using only MAC, nor exist solely to blast broadcasts in L3 mode.

enunciado: Which cable type must be used to interconnect one switch using 1000 BASE-SX GBIC modufiles and another switch using 1000 BASE-SX SFPmodufiles?
alternativas: LC to SC
SC to SC
LC to LC
SC to ST
explicacao_profunda: GBIC SX links typically use SC connectors; interconnecting two SC GBICs needs SC-to-SC fiber. LC is SFP-era more often; ST is another form factor.

enunciado: What is a benefit of a point-to-point leased line?
alternativas: low cost
full-mesh capability
simplicity of configuration
flflexibility of design
explicacao_profunda: Point-to-point leased lines are simple to configure (two endpoints, clear L3). They are not low-cost or full-mesh by nature.

enunciado: What is the role of nonoverlapping channels in a wireless environment?
alternativas: to increase bandwidth
to stabilize the RF environment
to allow for channel bonding
to reduce interference
explicacao_profunda: Nonoverlapping channels reduce co-channel interference and stabilize RF performance. They do not by themselves invent bandwidth or define bonding.

enunciado: What is the purpose of the service-set identifier?
alternativas: It identifies the wireless network to which an application must connect.
It identifies the wired network to which a network device is connected.
It identifies the wired network to which a user device is connected.
It identifies a wireless network for a mobile device to connect.
explicacao_profunda: The SSID identifies a wireless network so clients can discover and connect. It does not identify wired VLANs/networks.

enunciado: Which is a fact related to FTP?
alternativas: It always operates without user authentication.
It uses block numbers to identify and mitigate data-transfer errors.
It uses two separate connections for control and data tra
It relies on the well-known UDP port 69.
explicacao_profunda: FTP uses separate control and data TCP connections. TFTP uses UDP/69 and block numbers; FTP authenticates users.

enunciado: How do UTP and STP cabfiles compare?
alternativas: UTP cabfifiles provide faster and more reliable data transfer rates and STP cabfifiles are slower and less reliable.
STP cabfifiles are shielded and protect against electromagnetic interference and UTP lacks the same protection against electromagneticinterference.
STP cabfifiles are cheaper to procure and easier to install and UTP cabfifiles are more expensive and harder to install.
UTP cabfifiles are less prone to crosstalk and interference and STP cabfifiles are more prone to crosstalk and interference.
explicacao_profunda: STP cable has shielding against EMI; UTP does not. UTP is usually cheaper; STP is not generally faster Ethernet by definition.

enunciado: Which technology allows for multiple operating systems to be run on a single host computer?
alternativas: virtual routing and forwarding
virtual device contexts
network port ID virtualization
server virtualization
explicacao_profunda: Server virtualization runs multiple OSes on one physical host via a hypervisor. VRF/VDC/NPIV are networking virtualization concepts.

enunciado: Why would an administrator choose to implement an automated network management solution?
alternativas: to reduce operational costs
to support simpler password policies
to enable “box by box” configuration and deployment
to limit recurrent management costs
explicacao_profunda: Automation reduces operational cost and human error versus box-by-box management. It does not aim to enforce simpler passwords as the primary reason.

enunciado: What is a function of the core and distribution layers in a collapsed-core architecture?
alternativas: The router can support HSRP for Layer 2 redundancy in an IPv6 network.
The core and distribution layers are deployed on two different devices to enable failover.
The router operates on a single device or a redundant pair.
The router must use IPv4 and IPv6 addresses at Layer 3.
explicacao_profunda: Collapsed-core combines core and distribution on the same device (or redundant pair). It is not two separate layers of devices.

enunciado: What must be considered before deploying virtual machines?
alternativas: resource limitations, such as the number of CPU cores and the amount of memory
support for physical peripherals, such as monitors, keyboards, and mice
whether to leverage VSM to map multiple virtual profficessors to two or more virtual machines
location of the virtual machines within the data center environment
explicacao_profunda: Before deploying VMs, plan CPU, memory, storage, and I/O capacity limits. Peripherals/location are secondary to resource sizing.

enunciado: What is a link-local all-nodes IPv6 multicast address?
explicacao_profunda: IPv6 all-nodes link-local multicast is ff02::1. fe80::/10 is link-local unicast; 2000::/3 global unicast examples are not all-nodes multicast.

enunciado: Which is a reason to implement IPv4 private addressing?
alternativas: Comply with PCI regulations.
Reduce the size of the forwarding table on network routers.
Reduce the risk of a network security breach.
Comply with local law.
explicacao_profunda: Private addressing reduces direct Internet exposure of hosts (with perimeter controls/NAT). It is not primarily PCI text or FIB reduction.

enunciado: Which signal frequency appears 60 times per minute?
alternativas: 1 Hz signal
1 GHz signal
60 Hz signal
60 GHz signal
explicacao_profunda: Frequency f=1 Hz means one cycle per second = 60 cycles per minute. 60 Hz is 60 cycles per second.

enunciado: What is a function of an endpoint?
alternativas: It passes unicast communication between hosts in a network.
It transmits broadcast traffic between devices in the same VLAN.
It provides security between trusted and untrusted sections of the network.
It is used directly by an individual user to access network services.
explicacao_profunda: Endpoints (PCs, phones, printers) are used directly by users to access network services. Intermediate systems forward; fifirewalls zone.

enunciado: What is a function of MAC address learning?
alternativas: It is disabled by default on all interfaces connected to trunks.
It increases security on the management VLAN.
It is enabled by default on all VLANs and interfaces.
It increases the potential for MAC address flflooding.
explicacao_profunda: MAC learning is enabled by default so switches build the CAM table from source MACs on VLANs/ports. It does not inherently increase management VLAN security.

enunciado: Which IPv6 address range is suitable for anycast addresses for distributed services such as DHCP or DNS?
explicacao_profunda: Anycast is typically a unicast global address assigned to multiple hosts; 2001:db8::/32 documentation space /128 is a unicast form suitable as anycast target. ff00::/8 is multicast; fe80:: link-local.

enunciado: What is a similarity between OM3 and OM4 fiber optic cable?
alternativas: Both have a 62.5 micron core diameter.
Both have a 100 micron core diameter.
Both have a 50 micron core diameter.
Both have a 9 micron core diameter.
explicacao_profunda: OM3 and OM4 are 50 µm multimode fiber optimized for laser/VCSEL. OM1 is 62.5 µm; OS1/OS2 single-mode ~9 µm.

enunciado: Which device segregates a network into separate zones that have their own security policies?
alternativas: IPS
switch
access point
fifirewall
explicacao_profunda: fifirewalls create security zones with distinct policies. IPS detects threats; switches/APs segment differently.

enunciado: What is the primary purpose of private address space?
alternativas: limit the number of nodes reachable via the Internet
simplify the addressing in the network
conserve globally unique address space
reduce network complexity
explicacao_profunda: Private address space conserves public IPv4 by allowing internal reuse. Simplification/complexity reduction are secondary benefits.

enunciado: What is a characteristic of a collapsed-core network topology?
alternativas: It enabfifiles all workstations in a SOHO environment to connect on a single switch with internet access.
It enabfifiles the core and access layers to connect to one logical distribution device over an EtherChannel.
It allows wireless devices to connect directly to the core layer, which enabfifiles faster data transmission.
It allows the core and distribution layers to run as a single combined layer.
explicacao_profunda: Collapsed-core runs core+distribution functions together on one layer/pair of devices. Access still connects users.

enunciado: What is the functionality of the Cisco DNA Center?
alternativas: IP address pool distribution scheduler
data center network policy controller
console server that permits secure access to all network devices
software-defined controller for automation of devices and services
explicacao_profunda: DNA Center is the software-defined controller for automation, assurance, and policy of enterprise devices.

enunciado: Which functionality is provided by the console connection on a Cisco WLC?
alternativas: HTTP-based GUI connectivity
secure in-band connectivity for device administration
out-of-band management
unencrypted in-band connectivity for file transfers
